details.flavorMarkdown: *A tall woodland deer crowned with spreading antlers and supported by long, powerful legs. The herd follows its caution; in a rut or a crisis, that caution becomes a sudden charge.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Antler sweep

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Push 2. **Standard defense:** Push 1.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Deep hoof prints cross a fence without breaking it.

**Purpose:** Lead the herd away from danger.

**Tactics and retreat:** Drive one pursuer back, then run toward open ground.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Do not corner the herd; give its leader an escape route.

**Habitat:** Wilderness · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** A naturally shed antler may serve as a story clue or craft ingredient at the DA’s discretion.

**Summoning:** Animal 3 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/summons/great-stag.md).
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-great-stag


**Category:** Animal · **Role:** Line breaker · **CV:** 13

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.2

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=3.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [great stag guard the herd](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/great-stag-guard-the-herd.md).
